description: Use this when a visitor asks whether a park has reservations or blockout dates for a ticket or pass type on given dates at a supported resort. Returns availability by segment (ticket or pass type) for up to 7 days, from Disney's and Universal's own calendars.

date.description: First date, YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to today.

days.description: Number of days, 1 to 7; defaults to 3.

resort.description: Resort key or shorthand: wdw, dlr, uor or ush.

name: parky_get_park_availability
title: Get park reservation availability
